name: Footopia
source:
Hey stranger, do you like feet?

If not, our poor protagonist didn't either... until Lucy got her hands (and her feet) on him.

Footopia is a short story about what happens when a succubus with a foot fetish, Lucy, sets her sights on you. Follow our protagonist as he navigates this bizarre situation, encountering eight different girls along the way.

[From [url=https://footopia.itch.io/footopia]itch.io[/url]]
